evidence: Three high-level packages (commands, inline, subtitle) indicate logical modularization within a single deployable unit
Flat repository structure with only 2 levels of directory depth, no service boundaries or separate processes
Shared dependencies across modules (e.g., commands and inline both import from subtitle), indicating cohesion and internal coupling
Single entry point (bot.py) orchestrating all components, typical of monolithic architectures
No external service discovery, inter-process communication, or deployment isolation patterns observed
Low average fan-out (2.6) and only 3 packages suggest moderate modularity without distributed complexity
risks: Potential for tight coupling between modules as they share internal imports (e.g., commands/inline importing subtitle internals directly)
Scalability limitations due to monolithic deployment and lack of process isolation
Risk of increasing maintainability debt as new features are added without clear module boundaries
